011import dev.dejvokep.boostedyaml.YamlDocument;
012import net.tnemc.core.EconomyManager;
013import net.tnemc.core.TNECore;
014import net.tnemc.core.account.holdings.HoldingsEntry;
015import net.tnemc.core.api.response.AccountAPIResponse;
016import net.tnemc.core.currency.Currency;
017import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
018import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.log.DebugLevel;
019import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
020
021import java.io.File;
022import java.math.BigDecimal;
023import java.util.Optional;
024import java.util.Set;
025import java.util.UUID;
026import java.util.function.Function;
027
028/**
029 * Restores the pre-0.1.2 account extraction format for platform command adapters.
030 */
031public final class LegacyAccountRestorer {
032
033  private LegacyAccountRestorer() { }
034
035  public static boolean restore(@Nullable final Integer extraction,
036                                final Function<String, UUID> identifierResolver) {
037
038    final File file = new File(PluginCore.directory(), "extracted.yml");
039    if(!file.exists()) {
040      PluginCore.log().inform("The extraction file doesn't exist.", DebugLevel.OFF);
041      return false;
042    }
043
044    final YamlDocument extracted = load(file);
045    if(extracted == null) {
046      PluginCore.log().inform("The extraction file doesn't exist.", DebugLevel.OFF);
047      return false;
048    }
049    if(extracted.contains("Accounts")) {
050      restoreAccounts(extracted, identifierResolver);
051    }
052    return true;
053  }
054
055  private static YamlDocument load(final File file) {
056
057    try {
058      return YamlDocument.create(file);
059    } catch(final Exception e) {
060      PluginCore.log().error("Failed load extraction file for writing.", e, DebugLevel.OFF);
061      return null;
062    }
063  }
064
065  private static void restoreAccounts(final YamlDocument extracted,
066                                      final Function<String, UUID> identifierResolver) {
067
068    final Set<Object> accounts = extracted.getSection("Accounts").getKeys();
069    final int frequency = (int)(accounts.size() * 0.10);
070    final boolean recode = extracted.contains("Version");
071    final int[] number = { 1 };
072    for(final Object nameObj : accounts) {
073      restoreAccount(extracted, (String)nameObj, recode, identifierResolver, number, frequency,
074                     accounts.size());
075    }
076    PluginCore.log().inform("Restoration has completed!", DebugLevel.OFF);
077  }
078
079  private static void restoreAccount(final YamlDocument extracted, final String name, final boolean recode,
080                                     final Function<String, UUID> identifierResolver, final int[] number,
081                                     final int frequency, final int total) {
082
083    final String username = name.replaceAll("\\!", "\\.").replaceAll("\\@", "-").replaceAll("\\%", "_");
084    UUID identifier = identifierResolver.apply(username);
085    boolean nonPlayer = false;
086    if(identifier == null) {
087      nonPlayer = true;
088      identifier = UUID.randomUUID();
089    }
090
091    final AccountAPIResponse response = TNECore.eco().account().createAccount(
092            identifier.toString(), username, nonPlayer);
093    if(response.getAccount().isEmpty()) {
094      PluginCore.log().inform("Couldn't create account for " + username + ". Reason: "
095                              + response.getResponse().response(), DebugLevel.OFF);
096      return;
097    }
098
099    final Set<Object> regions = extracted.getSection("Accounts." + name + ".Balances").getKeys();
100    for(final Object regionObj : regions) {
101      restoreRegion(extracted, response, name, (String)regionObj, recode, number, frequency, total);
102    }
103  }
104
105  private static void restoreRegion(final YamlDocument extracted, final AccountAPIResponse response,
106                                    final String name, final String region, final boolean recode,
107                                    final int[] number, final int frequency, final int total) {
108
109    final Set<Object> currencies = extracted.getSection("Accounts." + name + ".Balances." + region).getKeys();
110    for(final Object currencyObj : currencies) {
111      final String currency = (String)currencyObj;
112      if(recode) {
113        restoreRecoded(extracted, response, name, region, currency);
114      } else {
115        restoreLegacy(extracted, response, name, region, currency);
116      }
117      number[0]++;
118      logProgress(number[0], frequency, total);
119    }
120  }
121
122  private static void restoreLegacy(final YamlDocument extracted, final AccountAPIResponse response,
123                                    final String name, final String region, final String currency) {
124
125    final String finalCurrency = currency.equalsIgnoreCase("default")
126                                 ? TNECore.eco().currency().defaultCurrency().getIdentifier() : currency;
127    final Optional<Currency> found = TNECore.eco().currency().find(finalCurrency);
128    final Currency currencyObj = found.orElseGet(
129            ()->TNECore.eco().currency().defaultCurrency(TNECore.eco().region().resolve(region)));
130    final BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
131            extracted.getString("Accounts." + name + ".Balances." + region + "." + currency));
132    response.getAccount().get().setHoldings(
133            new HoldingsEntry(TNECore.eco().region().resolve(region), currencyObj.getUid(), amount,
134                              EconomyManager.NORMAL),
135            TNECore.eco().getFor(currencyObj, currencyObj.type()).get(0).identifier());
136  }
137
138  private static void restoreRecoded(final YamlDocument extracted, final AccountAPIResponse response,
139                                     final String name, final String region, final String currency) {
140
141    final Set<Object> types = extracted.getSection(
142            "Accounts." + name + ".Balances." + region + "." + currency).getKeys();
143    for(final Object typeObj : types) {
144      final String type = (String)typeObj;
145      final BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(extracted.getString(
146              "Accounts." + name + ".Balances." + region + "." + currency + "." + type));
147      response.getAccount().get().setHoldings(new HoldingsEntry(region, UUID.fromString(currency), amount,
148                                                                 Identifier.fromID(type)));
149    }
150  }
151
152  private static void logProgress(final int number, final int frequency, final int total) {
153
154    try {
155      if(number % frequency == 0) {
156        PluginCore.log().inform("Restoration Progress: " + ((number * 100) / total), DebugLevel.OFF);
157      }
158    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
159  }
160}
